cases.prompt: Write a Kotlin program that prints "Hello, World!" to stdout.
cases.workflow:
# actions/checkout v7.0.1: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# actions/setup-java v6.0.1: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# fwilhe2/setup-kotlin v2.0: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# actions/setup-python v7.0.0: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# python 3.14.7: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# kotlin v2.4.20: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# java 25: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-09-30)
# coursier/setup-action v3.0.4: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-10-07)
# scala 2.13.18: (version resolved from the shipped baseline measured 2026-10-07)
# Runs Main.kt on every push and pull request with the commands the
# change was verified with.
name: Run Main.kt

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6  # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '25'
      - uses: fwilhe2/setup-kotlin@ee9692514da313706b193d808526812102a344e4  # v2.0
        with:
          version: '2.4.20'
      - run: |
          kotlinc Main.kt -include-runtime -d Main.jar
      - run: |
          sh tests/verify-output.sh
